examples.en: The warm kitchen smelled inviting after a long day at school.
examples.zh: 上了一整天的課後，溫暖的廚房聞起來很誘人。

examples.en: The hotel has an inviting lobby with soft chairs and fresh flowers.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的大廳很吸引人，有柔軟的椅子和新鮮的花。

examples.en: The cool, clear water of the lake looked very inviting.
examples.zh: 湖裡清涼又清澈的水看起來讓人很想下去。

examples.en: Parents' involvement in school activities helps children do better.
examples.zh: 家長參與學校活動有助於孩子表現得更好。

examples.en: The company denied any involvement in the accident.
examples.zh: 公司否認與這起意外有任何牽連。

examples.en: Her involvement in the project started last spring.
examples.zh: 她從去年春天開始參與這個專案。

examples.en: The door has an inward curve that makes it hard to open.
examples.zh: 這扇門有向內的弧度，所以很難打開。

examples.en: She felt an inward sense of calm before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，她內心感到一股平靜。

examples.en: An inward glance at his own habits helped him change.
examples.zh: 他審視自己的習慣，因而有所改變。

examples.en: The windows of the old house open inward.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的窗戶向內開。

examples.en: The box was folded inward to save space.
examples.zh: 這個盒子被向內摺起來以節省空間。

examples.en: Please turn the handle inward and then pull it.
examples.zh: 請把把手往內轉，然後拉開。

examples.en: The test is designed to measure a child's IQ.
examples.zh: 這項測驗是用來測量孩子的智商。

examples.en: A high IQ does not always mean a person is successful.
examples.zh: 高智商不一定代表一個人會成功。

examples.en: Our teacher said that IQ tests measure only some aspects of intelligence.
examples.zh: 老師說，智商測驗只能測量智力的部分面向。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread was irresistible to everyone in the shop.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓店裡的每個人都難以抗拒。

examples.en: The store is offering an irresistible discount this weekend.
examples.zh: 這家店本週末推出令人無法抗拒的折扣。

examples.en: The puppy's irresistible smile made us want to take it home.
examples.zh: 小狗那令人難以抗拒的笑臉讓我們想把牠帶回家。

examples.en: The club welcomes all students, irrespective of their grades.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎所有學生，不論成績如何。

examples.en: Tickets are sold on a first-come basis, irrespective of age.
examples.zh: 門票依先到先得販售，不分年齡。

examples.en: Irrespective of the weather, the game will start at noon.
examples.zh: 不論天氣如何，比賽都會在中午開始。

examples.en: Farmers in this area depend on irrigation during the dry season.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農民在乾季要靠灌溉。

examples.en: The government built a new irrigation system near the river.
examples.zh: 政府在河邊建造了新的灌溉系統。

examples.en: Good irrigation can double the amount of rice a farm produces.
examples.zh: 良好的灌溉可以讓農場的稻米產量加倍。

senses.zh: 惱怒；（皮膚等的）刺激不適；惱人的事物

examples.en: He could not hide his irritation when the bus was late again.
examples.zh: 公車又誤點時，他藏不住心中的惱怒。

examples.en: The cream helps reduce skin irritation caused by the sun.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜有助於減輕日曬造成的皮膚刺激不適。

examples.en: The loud music was a constant irritation to our neighbors.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的音樂讓鄰居們一直很心煩。

examples.en: Dad used a jack to lift the car and change the tire.
examples.zh: 爸爸用千斤頂把車抬起來換輪胎。

examples.en: Plug the headphones into the jack on the side of the laptop.
examples.zh: 把耳機插進筆電側邊的插孔。

examples.en: She played the jack of hearts and won the card game.
examples.zh: 她打出紅心 J，贏了這場紙牌遊戲。

examples.en: Students are told not to jaywalk in front of the school.
examples.zh: 學生被告知不要在學校前面亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: Many people jaywalk when the street looks empty.
examples.zh: 許多人在馬路上看起來沒車時就亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: The sign warns people not to jaywalk at this busy corner.
examples.zh: 告示牌提醒大家不要在這個繁忙的路口亂穿越馬路。

examples.en: Some fans began to jeer when the team lost the ball.
examples.zh: 球隊失誤丟球時，一些球迷開始奚落。

examples.en: It is rude to jeer at someone who makes a mistake.
examples.zh: 嘲笑犯錯的人是很沒禮貌的。

examples.en: The crowd jeered at the singer after he forgot the words.
examples.zh: 歌手忘詞後，群眾對他發出嘲笑聲。

examples.en: A loud jeer came from the back of the room.
examples.zh: 房間後方傳來一聲響亮的譏笑。

examples.en: He ignored the jeers and kept playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他不理會那些嘲笑，繼續彈鋼琴。

examples.en: The speaker was met with cheers and a few jeers.
examples.zh: 講者受到一片歡呼，也有幾聲嘲笑。

examples.en: Skipping safety checks could jeopardize the whole trip.
examples.zh: 省略安全檢查可能會危害整趟旅程。

examples.en: Poor grades may jeopardize his chance of entering that school.
examples.zh: 成績不好可能會危及他進入那所學校的機會。

examples.en: The delay will jeopardize our plan to open the store on time.
examples.zh: 這次延誤將危及我們準時開店的計畫。

examples.en: He jerked the door open and ran outside.
examples.zh: 他猛然拉開門，衝了出去。

examples.en: The bus jerked forward and the passengers almost fell.
examples.zh: 公車猛然向前一晃，乘客差點跌倒。

examples.en: She jerked her hand away from the hot pan.
examples.zh: 她猛地把手從熱鍋子上縮開。

senses.zh: 突然的猛動；混蛋（非正式貶義）

examples.en: The train stopped with a sudden jerk.
examples.zh: 火車突然猛地停了下來。

examples.en: With one jerk, he pulled the heavy box off the shelf.
examples.zh: 他用力一拉，把沉重的箱子從架上拉了下來。

examples.en: Nobody likes working with a jerk who ignores other people.
examples.zh: 沒有人喜歡和不顧別人的混蛋共事。

examples.en: My brother wears his baseball jersey to every game.
examples.zh: 我哥哥每場比賽都穿他的棒球球衣。

examples.en: Her new dress is made of soft, stretchy jersey.
examples.zh: 她的新洋裝是用柔軟、有彈性的針織布製成的。

examples.en: The warm wool jersey kept him comfortable on the cold hike.
examples.zh: 這件溫暖的羊毛針織衫讓他在寒冷的健行中很舒適。

examples.en: Many jobless workers attended the job fair this weekend.
examples.zh: 許多失業勞工參加了本週末的就業博覽會。

examples.en: He was jobless for six months before he found a new position.
examples.zh: 他失業了六個月才找到新職位。

examples.en: The city is helping jobless young people learn new skills.
examples.zh: 市府正在協助失業的年輕人學習新技能。

examples.en: The judiciary is independent from the government.
examples.zh: 司法機關獨立於行政部門。

examples.en: Students visited the court to learn how the judiciary works.
examples.zh: 學生們參觀法院，了解司法系統如何運作。

examples.en: A fair judiciary is important for a healthy society.
examples.zh: 公正的司法體系對健全的社會很重要。

senses.zh: 套頭毛衣（英式）；無袖連身裙（美式）；跳躍者

examples.en: She is the best high jumper on our school team.
examples.zh: 她是我們校隊中最厲害的跳高選手。

examples.en: Mom knitted a warm jumper for my little sister.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我妹妹織了一件溫暖的套頭毛衣。

examples.en: The school uniform includes a blue jumper worn over a white shirt.
examples.zh: 這所學校的制服包含一件穿在白襯衫外的藍色無袖連身裙。

examples.en: There is no justification for being rude to customers.
examples.zh: 對顧客無禮是沒有正當理由的。

examples.en: The manager asked for a clear justification of the extra cost.
examples.zh: 經理要求清楚說明這筆額外費用的理由。

examples.en: Her late arrival needs no justification because the train broke down.
examples.zh: 她遲到不需要辯解，因為火車故障了。

examples.en: Her anger was justified because the waiter forgot her order twice.
examples.zh: 服務生兩度忘了她點的餐，她的生氣是合理的。

examples.en: The teacher felt justified in giving the student extra homework.
examples.zh: 老師覺得給那位學生額外的作業是合理的。

examples.en: The high price is justified by the excellent quality.
examples.zh: 優良的品質使這個高價格有其道理。

examples.en: Each kernel of corn is covered with a thin skin.
examples.zh: 每一粒玉米的外面都包著一層薄皮。

examples.en: He cracked the nut and ate the sweet kernel inside.
examples.zh: 他敲開堅果，吃掉裡面香甜的果仁。

examples.en: The kernel of her speech was that everyone should help.
examples.zh: 她演講的核心就是大家都應該幫忙。

examples.en: Heart disease is a major killer in many countries.
examples.zh: 心臟病在許多國家是主要的致命疾病。

examples.en: The detective spent years looking for the killer.
examples.zh: 那位偵探花了好幾年尋找兇手。

examples.en: Stress is a silent killer that affects many office workers.
examples.zh: 壓力是無聲的殺手，影響許多上班族。

senses.zh: 致命的；極出色的（非正式）

examples.en: The science lesson explained how killer diseases spread through communities.
examples.zh: 科學課說明了致命疾病如何在社區傳播。

examples.en: She prepared a killer presentation for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她為這場會議準備了一份超棒的簡報。

examples.en: The weather report warned hikers about a killer heat wave.
examples.zh: 氣象報告提醒登山客留意致命的熱浪。

examples.en: The killing of wild animals is against the law here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，獵殺野生動物是違法的。

examples.en: The newspaper reported a killing near the old harbor.
examples.zh: 報紙報導了舊港口附近的一起殺人案。

examples.en: He made a killing by selling his old comic books online.
examples.zh: 他在網路上賣掉舊漫畫書，大賺了一筆。

examples.en: The company has the know-how to build fast trains.
examples.zh: 這家公司有建造高速列車的技術。

examples.en: Learning to cook takes practice and some basic know-how.
examples.zh: 學做菜需要練習，也要有一些基本的訣竅。

examples.en: We need someone with technical know-how to fix the network.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位有技術知識的人來修理網路。

examples.en: He knocked on the door with his knuckle.
examples.zh: 他用指關節敲了敲門。

examples.en: She hurt her knuckle when she hit the table by mistake.
examples.zh: 她不小心撞到桌子，弄傷了指關節。

examples.en: The boxer wrapped tape around each knuckle before practice.
examples.zh: 拳擊手練習前在每個指關節上纏上膠帶。

senses.zh: 跛的；差勁的；站不住腳的

examples.en: The lame horse could not run in the race.
examples.zh: 那匹跛腳的馬無法參加賽跑。

examples.en: I thought the movie was lame, so I left early.
examples.zh: 我覺得那部電影很差勁，所以提早離開了。

examples.en: His excuse for missing class was too lame to believe.
examples.zh: 他缺課的藉口太站不住腳，讓人無法相信。

examples.en: Fans lament the loss of the old stadium.
examples.zh: 球迷們為舊球場的消失感到惋惜。

examples.en: She lamented the fact that summer vacation was over.
examples.zh: 她為暑假結束這件事感到惋惜。

examples.en: Many parents lament how little time they have with their kids.
examples.zh: 許多家長感嘆自己和孩子相處的時間太少。

examples.en: The singer wrote a lament for her lost home town.
examples.zh: 這位歌手為失去的家鄉寫了一首哀歌。

examples.en: A long lament rose from the crowd.
examples.zh: 群眾中傳出一陣長長的悲嘆。

examples.en: His lament about the high rent was heard by everyone.
examples.zh: 他對高房租的抱怨大家都聽到了。

examples.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the strong wind.
examples.zh: 儘管風很大，飛機仍平穩降落。

examples.en: We waited on the landing between the first and second floors.
examples.zh: 我們在一樓與二樓之間的樓梯平台等候。

examples.en: The pilot announced that the landing would be in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 機長廣播十分鐘後就要降落。

examples.en: The city plans a large-scale project to improve public parks.
examples.zh: 市府計畫推動大規模的專案來改善公園。

examples.en: There was a large-scale sale at the mall this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個週末購物中心有一場大規模的促銷。

examples.en: Large-scale farming needs a lot of water and machines.
examples.zh: 大規模的農耕需要大量的水和機器。

examples.en: She put mascara on her lashes before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前，她在睫毛上刷了睫毛膏。

examples.en: The rider gave the horse a light lash with the whip.
examples.zh: 騎士用鞭子輕輕抽了馬一下。

examples.en: A dust particle on his lash made his eye water.
examples.zh: 睫毛上的一粒灰塵讓他的眼睛流淚。

examples.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整晚猛烈拍打著窗戶。

examples.en: The sailors lashed the boxes to the deck.
examples.zh: 水手們把箱子綁在甲板上。

examples.en: The coach lashed out at the team for their careless play.
examples.zh: 教練為球隊粗心的表現痛罵了一頓。

examples.en: The trip left us with lasting memories of the beautiful coast.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行讓我們對美麗的海岸留下了長久的回憶。

examples.en: They hope to build a lasting friendship with their new classmates.
examples.zh: 他們希望和新同學建立長久的友誼。

examples.en: Good habits can have a lasting effect on your health.
examples.zh: 好習慣能對你的健康產生長遠的影響。

examples.en: Every child has latent talents that teachers can help bring out.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都有潛在的才能，老師可以幫忙發掘出來。

examples.en: The virus can stay latent in the body for years.
examples.zh: 這種病毒可以在體內潛伏數年。

examples.en: There was a latent conflict between the two departments.
examples.zh: 這兩個部門之間存在著潛在的衝突。

examples.en: Hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
examples.zh: 熾熱的熔岩沿著火山側邊緩緩流下。

examples.en: The lava cooled and turned into black rock.
examples.zh: 熔岩冷卻後變成了黑色的岩石。

examples.en: Scientists watched the lava from a safe distance.
examples.zh: 科學家從安全的距離觀察熔岩。

examples.en: This laptop has a bright LCD that is easy on the eyes.
examples.zh: 這台筆電的液晶螢幕明亮，看起來很舒服。

examples.en: The LCD on the microwave shows the time.
examples.zh: 微波爐上的液晶顯示器會顯示時間。

examples.en: Dad bought a new LCD for his home office.
examples.zh: 爸爸為他的家庭辦公室買了一台新的液晶螢幕。

examples.en: The teacher used a short story as a lead-in to the lesson.
examples.zh: 老師用一則小故事作為這堂課的開場。

examples.en: Her joke was a good lead-in to the main topic.
examples.zh: 她的笑話是切入主題的好開場。

examples.en: The lead-in to the news report was too long.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導的引言太長了。

examples.en: The boat anchored in the lee of the island to avoid the wind.
examples.zh: 船停泊在島的背風處以避風。

examples.en: We sat in the lee of the wall and had our lunch.
examples.zh: 我們坐在牆的避風處吃午餐。

examples.en: The sailors sheltered in the lee of the rocks until the storm passed.
examples.zh: 水手們躲在岩石的背風處，直到風暴過去。

examples.en: The newspaper is known for its left-wing views.
examples.zh: 這份報紙以左派觀點聞名。

examples.en: He joined a left-wing group at university.
examples.zh: 他在大學時加入了一個左派團體。

examples.en: The left-wing party promised to raise the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 這個左翼政黨承諾要提高基本工資。

examples.en: The legislature passed a new law to protect rivers.
examples.zh: 立法機關通過了一項保護河川的新法律。

examples.en: Members of the legislature meet in the capital every year.
examples.zh: 立法機關的成員每年都在首都開會。

examples.en: Our class took a field trip to visit the state legislature.
examples.zh: 我們班去校外教學，參觀了州議會。

examples.en: Choose the lesser of the two prices if the quality is the same.
examples.zh: 如果品質相同，就選兩者中較便宜的價格。

examples.en: The second storm was of lesser intensity than the first.
examples.zh: 第二場暴風雨的強度比第一場弱。

examples.en: He cares more about grades than about lesser matters like clothes.
examples.zh: 他比較在乎成績，而不是衣服之類較次要的事。

examples.en: Push the lever down to open the box.
examples.zh: 把操縱桿往下壓，就能打開箱子。

examples.en: A long lever makes it easier to lift a heavy rock.
examples.zh: 長長的槓桿讓人更容易抬起沉重的石頭。

examples.en: The company used low prices as a lever to win new customers.
examples.zh: 公司以低價作為手段來爭取新客戶。

examples.en: He levered the lid off the paint can with a spoon.
examples.zh: 他用湯匙把油漆桶的蓋子撬開。

examples.en: The workers levered the stone out of the ground.
examples.zh: 工人們把石頭從地裡撬了出來。

examples.en: She levered open the window with a small tool.
examples.zh: 她用一把小工具把窗戶撬開。

examples.en: The city added a small levy to every plastic bag.
examples.zh: 市政府對每個塑膠袋加徵一小筆稅。

examples.en: Companies must pay a levy on imported goods.
examples.zh: 公司必須為進口貨物繳納稅款。

examples.en: The new levy will help pay for public transport.
examples.zh: 這項新的稅款將用來補助大眾運輸。

examples.en: The government decided to levy a tax on sugary drinks.
examples.zh: 政府決定對含糖飲料課稅。

examples.en: Some towns levy fees on tourists who stay overnight.
examples.zh: 有些城鎮向過夜的遊客徵收費用。

examples.en: The school may levy a fine for late library books.
examples.zh: 學校可能會對逾期未還的圖書收取罰款。

examples.en: The singer sued the magazine for libel.
examples.zh: 那位歌手控告這本雜誌誹謗。

examples.en: Printing false stories about a person can be libel.
examples.zh: 刊登不實的報導來中傷某人可能構成誹謗。

examples.en: The court decided that the article was not libel.
examples.zh: 法院判定這篇文章不構成誹謗。

examples.en: The government plans to liberalize trade with other countries.
examples.zh: 政府計畫放寬與其他國家的貿易管制。

examples.en: Many countries liberalized their rules for foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 許多國家放寬了對外國旅客的規定。

examples.en: The company wants to liberalize its dress code for office workers.
examples.zh: 公司想放寬上班族的服裝規定。

examples.en: Every passenger must know where the lifeboat is on the ship.
examples.zh: 每位乘客都必須知道船上的救生艇在哪裡。

examples.en: The crew lowered a lifeboat into the water.
examples.zh: 船員把救生艇放到水面上。

examples.en: Children and elderly people were helped into the lifeboat first.
examples.zh: 孩童和年長者先被協助上了救生艇。

examples.en: The lighting in the library is soft and good for reading.
examples.zh: 圖書館的燈光柔和，很適合閱讀。

examples.en: We changed the lighting in the living room to save energy.
examples.zh: 我們更換了客廳的照明設備以節省能源。

examples.en: Good lighting makes the photo look much better.
examples.zh: 良好的燈光讓這張照片看起來好很多。

examples.en: I bought a lightweight jacket for the trip.
examples.zh: 我為這趟旅行買了一件輕便的外套。

examples.en: This lightweight laptop is easy to carry to class.
examples.zh: 這台輕巧的筆電很方便帶去上課。

examples.en: The lightweight tent can be packed into a small bag.
examples.zh: 這頂輕量帳篷可以收進一個小袋子裡。

senses.zh: 輕量級；體重較輕的人；無足輕重的人物（貶義）

examples.en: The boxer moved up from lightweight to a heavier group.
examples.zh: 這位拳擊手從輕量級升到了較重的量級。

examples.en: Many people think of him as a lightweight in politics.
examples.zh: 許多人認為他在政壇上是個無足輕重的人物。

examples.en: She is a lightweight at only forty-five kilograms.
examples.zh: 她只有四十五公斤，是個體重較輕的人。

examples.en: Add a slice of lime to the cold drink.
examples.zh: 在冰飲裡加一片萊姆。

examples.en: The farmer spread lime on the soil to help the plants grow.
examples.zh: 農夫把石灰撒在土壤上，幫助植物生長。

examples.en: She squeezed fresh lime juice over the fish.
examples.zh: 她把新鮮的萊姆汁擠在魚上。

senses.zh: 大型豪華轎車；機場接駁車

examples.en: A black limousine was waiting outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 一輛黑色豪華轎車正在飯店外等候。

examples.en: The bride arrived at the church in a white limousine.
examples.zh: 新娘乘坐白色豪華轎車抵達教堂。

examples.en: We took the airport limousine to the city center.
examples.zh: 我們搭機場接駁車前往市中心。

senses.zh: 直線的；線性的；按順序發展的

examples.en: The graph shows a linear increase in sales.
examples.zh: 這張圖顯示銷售額呈線性成長。

examples.en: In math class, we learned how to solve a linear equation.
examples.zh: 我們在數學課學會了如何解線性方程式。

examples.en: The story does not follow a linear order from start to end.
examples.zh: 這個故事並不是依照時間先後順序從頭說到尾。

senses.zh: 陣容；節目表；（供警方指認的）列隊

examples.en: The coach announced the starting lineup before the game.
examples.zh: 教練在比賽前公布了先發陣容。

examples.en: The witness identified the suspect in a lineup at the police station.
examples.zh: 目擊者在警局的指認列隊中認出了嫌疑人。

examples.en: The TV station changed its Friday night lineup.
examples.zh: 這家電視台更動了週五晚間的節目陣容。

senses.zh: 語言學家；精通多國語言的人

examples.en: The linguist studies how children learn their first language.
examples.zh: 這位語言學家研究孩子如何學會第一種語言。

examples.en: My aunt is a talented linguist who speaks five languages.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是很有天分的語言通，會說五種語言。

examples.en: A famous linguist gave a talk at our university.
examples.zh: 一位知名的語言學家在我們大學演講。
